definitions.explanation: The first one in a sequence, or the starting point of something. Can function as a noun or adverbial expression.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{最初|さいしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{最初|さいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: {最初|さいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is the adverbial form: "first," "to begin with."

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧{最初|さいしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: On my first day in Japan, I didn't understand anything and it was tough.

notes:
{最初|さいしょ} means "first" or "beginning" and can function as a noun or adverbially.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {最初|さいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: first, at first (adverbial)
- {最初|さいしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the beginning
- {最初|さいしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: at first, initially
- {最初|さいしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: the first ~ (attributive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最初|さいしょ}: the first (in sequence/time), beginning
- ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧: for the first time (first experience)
- ⟦{初|はじ}め→はじめ：02931_hajime⟧: beginning (often in ⟦{初|はじ}め→はじめ：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
Opposite of ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧ (last, end).

WHY 最初は OFTEN SIGNALS A CHANGE:
Because ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ contrasts, {最初|さいしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ almost always sets up a "but later…" clause. A listener hearing it expects the situation to have changed:
{最初|さいしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{慣|な}れた→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
(It was difficult at first, but I gradually got used to it.)
By contrast, {最初|さいしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ simply orders steps and implies no such reversal.
